topic: Indonesia: nationalist movements, youth politics, and anti-colonial organization before 1945
scope_decisions: The folder stays focused on organized nationalism, youth politics, and anti-colonial organization before 1945.
The narrative includes the Japanese occupation only as a pre-1945 reconfiguration of nationalist organization.
Post-1945 independence history is intentionally excluded.
decisions: Use English for PDF-facing prose and Latin-script Indonesian terms only when they clarify historical usage.
Treat the Youth Pledge as a political and organizational hinge rather than a stand-alone ceremonial event.
Keep figures and tables qualitative so the folder remains stable across source revisions.
Avoid unstable exact counts for membership, arrests, or crowd sizes unless a later canonical recipe requires them.
